baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative فذرهم, the paired subjunctives يخوضوا ويلعبوا, and the terminal construction حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Non-intervention opens a bounded interval: they enter confused or blameworthy business and pursue action without a sound aim, but حتى closes that interval at a face-to-face, time-fixed threat.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting something be supplies the imperative suspension of intervention.
Entering talk or an affair, especially confused or false talk, identifies the activity filling the interval.
Action without a sound aim makes their activity purposeless rather than merely recreational.
The coming together of facing things turns the endpoint into an unavoidable encounter.
A bounded duration of time gives the encounter a temporal container.
A threat of evil fixes the negative valence of what has been announced.
An appointment bounded by time or place makes the threat a scheduled terminus.

changed_reading.before: A command to ignore people who are wasting time until a future day.
changed_reading.after: A controlled reprieve lets purposeless immersion run, but only inside an interval already closed by a scheduled threatening encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion sequence يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلاقوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Material branches make the clause kinetic: wading and stirring generate mixed lateral motion, wind-like play loses a stable course, and meeting compresses that dispersion into convergence at a narrow place and severe event.

activation_trace.role: Going into water supplies immersion in a medium rather than detached observation.
Stirring a drink until it mixes supplies churn and loss of clean separation.
Wind's wandering and losing its way supplies ungoverned lateral movement.
Two facing things coming together converts dispersion into convergence.
A meeting place or constriction gives convergence a spatial bottleneck.
The severe event of a day makes the bottleneck consequential rather than neutral.

changed_reading.before: They move aimlessly until time runs out.
changed_reading.after: They are allowed immersed, mixing, directionless motion only until every loose trajectory converges at a severe terminal bottleneck.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relation between ذرهم and ما يلقاه المرء embedded in يلاقوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command hands the subjects away from immediate correction and toward what they themselves will encounter; the promised day functions as the lot or consequence that receives them, not merely a date they observe.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or abandoning supplies a handoff away from the addressee's immediate intervention.
What a person meets of good or evil makes the endpoint an experienced lot or consequence.
A day's severe event turns the temporal noun into an event that acts upon its participants.
Threatened harm supplies the consequence toward which the handoff runs.

changed_reading.before: Leave them alone for now because punishment comes later.
changed_reading.after: Release them from present intervention into the conduct they choose until the announced consequence becomes the lot they personally encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence makes the endpoint requested, painful, already falling or fixed, undeflectable, and measured. The far/near reversal then relocates delay from the event's certainty to the subjects' perception, so ذرهم is calibrated restraint rather than uncertainty or indifference.

activation_trace.role: Letting them be supplies a deliberately maintained interval before the endpoint.
Facing convergence supplies the endpoint whose timing is recalibrated by context.
A time- or place-bounded appointment supplies the fixed terminus.
Asking or requesting makes the announced event an explicitly solicited challenge.
Pain and punishment identify the object requested and the threat met in the focus.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies accomplished certainty rather than a merely possible future.
Pushing away what is unwelcome, here negated, removes any escape valve from the endpoint.
A quantity reaching its set limit supplies calibrated scale to the apparent delay.
Distance from nearness states the subjects' temporal appraisal.
Time drawing near and a thing reaching completion reverses their appraisal and closes the interval.

structural_cues: 70:1-4 orders request, painful occurrence, non-deflection, and immense measured duration.
70:6-7 gives an explicit antithesis between what they see as far and what the speaker sees as near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the requested, fixed, undeflectable punishment, its measure, and the far/near reversal; I infer that these make حتى certain timing and ذرهم strategic restraint. A live alternative is that far/near contrasts viewpoints without explaining the imperative.

changed_reading.before: The command postpones concern until an unspecified future threat.
changed_reading.after: The command preserves a measured reprieve before an already fixed and undeflectable appointment whose apparent distance is a perceptual error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context couples failed kinship rescue with a person who turns away, gathers, and puts away. Against that sequence, خوض and لعب become a self-enclosing economy of mixed talk and purposeless accumulation; the same enclosure offers no separation, ransom, or shelter when punishment calls and extracts.

activation_trace.role: Stirring until things intermingle supplies the subjects' enclosing churn.
Aimless action marks that churn as lacking a sound outward end.
A detached piece supplies an exploratory image of the severance implicit in being left to this course.
Close kinship supplies the strongest social bond, which the verse renders non-responsive.
Putting one thing forward as ransom for another supplies the attempted exchange that fails.
A person's close clan supplies the wider protective unit that also cannot shelter him.
Gathering dispersed things into one supplies accumulation as the inward social and material motion.
Escape by separation supplies the rescue outcome that even total ransom cannot produce.
Pulling something from its settled place supplies punishment's counter-motion to hoarded containment.
Calling and drawing by speech personifies punishment as summoning its fitting subjects.
Turning the back and refusing supplies the conduct answered by that summons.
Putting a thing inside a container completes the image of hoarded self-enclosure.

structural_cues: 70:10-14 expands the failed ransom circle from intimate relation through clan to everyone on earth.
70:17-18 pairs turning away with gathering and containing as the profile explicitly summoned by the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed relational exchange, extraction, summons, turning away, gathering, and containment; I infer that the chosen conduct forms an enclosure that cannot rescue its maker. A live alternative is that the summons only identifies its subjects and does not imply this causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Their immersion and play are generic frivolity during a delay.
changed_reading.after: Their interval is an inward-turning practice of mixed talk and accumulation that matures into isolation: kin cannot exchange for them, stores cannot contain safety, and punishment extracts what they enclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The middle section defines two temporal regimes. Reactive humanity churns at each touch, losing patience under harm and withholding under good; the exception sustains repeated worship, fixed dues, verified promise, guarded boundaries, and preserved covenant. Playing until the Day therefore becomes failure to let the future claim organize present continuity.

activation_trace.role: Stirring a mixture supplies reactive churn from one immediate stimulus to another.
Action without a sound aim names conduct not governed by a durable end.
Extended time supplies the horizon across which present conduct either coheres or fragments.
A fixed appointment supplies the future end capable of governing present practice.
Greedy panic and quick agitation supply the unstable baseline human rhythm.
Patience breaking under harm supplies discontinuity at one pole of experience.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies closure at the opposite pole of experience.
The specific worship practice opens the exception as embodied directed action.
Stillness and duration make that directed action continuous rather than stimulus-bound.
A binding due and fixed entitlement turns wealth outward on a stable rule.
Making a promise true in action links announced future and present performance.
Accounting and recompense make the Day a present evaluative horizon.
Care mixed with fear supplies alert orientation toward the threatened future.
Persistent observance supplies repeated maintenance against distraction.
Preserving something from state to state supplies continuity across changing moments.
Rising with resolve to an affair supplies active steadiness rather than passive duration.

structural_cues: 70:19-21 uses matched conditionals to show oscillation between panic at harm and withholding at good.
70:22-34 brackets a long list of stable practices with prayer, first as continuous and then as guarded.
The fixed due in 70:24-25 and the Day of accounting in 70:26 connect future orientation to present distribution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reactive oscillation and a formally bracketed list of continuous, guarded obligations; I infer that this list defines the functional opposite of لعب as time without a governing end. A live alternative is that it only classifies a separate righteous group without redefining the focus activity.

changed_reading.before: Play is simply unserious behavior before judgment.
changed_reading.after: Play is a broken way of inhabiting time: immediate touches govern panic and withholding, while the promised Day fails to generate continuous worship, fixed giving, guarded limits, and kept commitments in the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crowd already performs an eager approach toward the addressee while presuming entry into the garden. Yet this voluntary facing is grouped, acquisitive, and rebutted by replaceability and inability to outrun. The focus encounter becomes the true convergence that their staged approach cannot secure or control.

activation_trace.role: Entering talk or an affair supplies their present involvement around the addressee.
Action without a sound aim disqualifies mere proximity as purposeful approach.
Facing convergence supplies the real encounter contrasted with their present crowding.
A garden enclosed and covered by trees supplies the destination they presume is open to them.
One thing facing another supplies their bodily orientation toward the addressee.
Rushing forward supplies eager approach without establishing rightful arrival.
The heart's covetous hope supplies the motive behind their approach.
Passing into an interior supplies the admission they expect from proximity.
One thing standing in another's place makes the crowd replaceable rather than entitled.
Escaping a pursuer, here denied, removes control over the eventual meeting.

structural_cues: 70:36-37 arranges the crowd before the addressee from right and left in separate groups.
70:38 converts their bodily approach into an expectation of admission, and 70:39-41 rejects entitlement through creation, replacement, and non-escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies eager facing, grouped proximity, hoped-for entry, replaceability, and non-escape; I infer that the scene is a false rehearsal of meeting, where voluntary crowding cannot control the true encounter. A live alternative is that the crowd scene is only mockery or listening and does not prefigure the endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They play now and will later meet the promised Day.
changed_reading.after: Their eager crowding around the addressee is already a failed kind of meeting: proximity serves acquisitive hope, while the true encounter arrives beyond their control and without guaranteed entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final verses resolve the endpoint as a bodily reversal. Presently the subjects wade, wander, and choose their own aimless vectors; then they exit graves together at speed toward an erected marker while sight lowers and humiliation overtakes them. Meeting the Day is therefore a transfer of agency from self-directed dispersion to compelled convergence.

activation_trace.role: Letting them be supplies the temporary phase in which their motion remains unrestrained.
Wading through a medium supplies self-propelled but medium-bound movement.
Wind wandering among places supplies directionless freedom before the reversal.
Two facing things converging supplies the terminal gathering of trajectories.
A time- or place-fixed appointment supplies the destination governing the reversal.
The severe event of the Day turns the temporal endpoint into the active scene of reversal.
Passing outward from an interior supplies the collective transition into exposure.
The grave supplies the enclosed origin from which the final motion begins.
The opposite of slowness gives the reversal sudden collective speed.
An erected marker or boundary stone supplies a visible fixed target for convergence.
Lowering and submission register the loss of the gaze's former initiative.
Overtaking and overpowering makes humiliation an arriving force rather than an inner mood.
Brokenness under compulsion supplies the bodily and social result of transferred agency.
The repeated fixed appointment explicitly identifies this kinetic scene as the focus verse's endpoint.

structural_cues: 70:43 repeats يوم immediately after the focus and shifts from permissive subjunctives to coordinated plural emergence and speed.
The final rushing verb in 70:43, rooted as و ف ض, has no branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue reinforcing rapid directed motion.
70:44 repeats the relative promise formula from 70:42 and deictically identifies this scene as that Day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies free-looking motion, collective grave-exit, speed toward a marker, lowered sight, overpowering humiliation, and exact promise repetition; I infer a transfer from chosen dispersion to compelled convergence. A live alternative is that the marker comparison emphasizes haste without implying coercion.

changed_reading.before: The Day is a deadline that eventually interrupts their play.
changed_reading.after: The Day reverses their whole motion regime: self-directed immersion becomes rapid emergence from enclosure, fixed-vector convergence, lowered sight, and overpowering humiliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines material branches and the non-dominant و ع د to ع و م split mapping; it remains anchored in the focus's wading, wind-wandering, meeting, and promised-time forms, plus packet water and horizon cues. Downstream prose should present it as a hydraulic-temporal image activated by branch resonance, not as a lexical translation of يوعدون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يخوضوا, ويلعبوا, يلاقوا, and the split-mapped يوعدون.

activation_trace.role: Entering water supplies immersion in a surrounding current.
Stirring a liquid supplies turbulence generated from within the medium.
Wind wandering among places supplies drift without a stable heading.
The split branch's swimming or gliding motion extends drift into the promised endpoint's sound-shape.
The split branch's year-cycle supplies recurrence beneath the focus's appointed time.
A meeting place or narrows supplies the channel where dispersed flow converges.
Surge, wave, and mutually driving abundance supply an external current that cannot be repelled.
Light rising from the east supplies one recurring horizon boundary.
Sunset and west supply the complementary recurring horizon boundary.

changed_reading.before: They idle freely until a fixed date.
changed_reading.after: They drift and stir inside a larger current whose recurring horizons make apparent freedom cyclical, until the flow is funneled into a terminal meeting-place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the saliva branch of ل ع ب and the speech-reception branch of ل ق ي; it remains anchored by the adjacent talk branch of خ و ض and the packet's sequence of asking, failed mutual inquiry, testimony, seeing, and lowered sight. Downstream prose should mark it as a mouth-and-reception resonance, not claim that يلعبوا ordinarily means drooling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of يخوضوا and يلعبوا before يلاقوا.

activation_trace.role: Entering intermingled talk supplies the verbal field of the present activity.
Saliva flowing from the mouth materializes unserious speech as uncontrolled oral output.
Receiving and being taught speech reverses output into reception at the endpoint.
Asking and requesting open the surah with provocative speech directed at the threat.
Reciprocal questioning, here negated, marks the collapse of ordinary speech exchange.
Visual perception shifts disclosure from disputing speech to forced seeing.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the disciplined counterform to intermingled talk.
Lowered submission of the eyes closes the sequence in non-discursive reception.

changed_reading.before: Their frivolous talk continues until the announced event occurs.
changed_reading.after: A permissive speech interval lets intermingled, uncontrolled mouth-output continue until the announced message can no longer be debated and is instead received as seen, embodied event.

strongest_changes: The opening context relocates delay from uncertainty to perspective: the threat is fixed, measured, undeflectable, and nearer than its subjects think.
The ethical middle recasts play as reactive and discontinuous time, opposed by practices that preserve obligation across changing conditions under the horizon of accounting.
The closing context turns meeting from a date into a transfer of agency: dispersed self-motion becomes rapid emergence, fixed-vector convergence, lowered sight, and overpowering humiliation.
The failed rescue and hoarding sequence makes immersion socially consequential as self-enclosure rather than generic entertainment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports coexisting temporal, social, and kinematic models. Most distinctive is the repeated reversal of apparent freedom: reprieve is bounded, crowding is not true arrival, accumulation is not shelter, and wandering motion ends in compelled convergence. Split-root material also preserves a contained hydraulic-cycle outlier without displacing the dominant promise reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ذرهم is best weighted as strategic non-intervention or as a judgmental handoff to consequence; both remain visibly anchored.
Whether the eager crowd of 70:36-38 intentionally rehearses the compelled rush of 70:43 or merely provides a separate contrast.
Whether the hydraulic-cycle activation is productive resonance or mostly an artifact of the non-dominant و ع د mapping.
Whether the mouth-to-reception outlier can support commentary beyond a carefully qualified imagistic note.
